Hi Ava — thanks for the quick note.

Medisprint's legal team is looking for three items in the initial evidence bundle:
1) SOC 2 type II summary + date range
2) Current subprocessor roster with region and a primary contact for each subprocessor
3) KMS / key management stance (high-level), and confirmation of GDPR data export safeguards (SCCs reference)

On the escrow: we are trying to avoid costly vendor escrow fees. A securely delivered, signed zip (SFTP link + hash) that you re-generate quarterly is acceptable for us for the pilot; legal wants a 12-month retention of each quarterly snapshot.

On SCCs, our counsel added a single paragraph about "on-site audit scope" that we think is reasonable but would like Redwood's confirmation. We can take a quick call to reconcile language.

Next steps: can your team share the evidence_matrix (or a pointer to the Drive folder) and confirm whether a signed zip is feasible? Also, please attach the order form draft you expect to route via DocuSign (we need to validate the exhibit names).

Alice — thanks, this is helpful. Looping in our contracts and legal leads.

Operational responses below and proposed short-call agenda:

1) Evidence bundle content (Ben): Ben will upload the filled evidence_matrix to the Drive by Wed EOD. We will provide the SOC 2 summary + attestation link; full PDF requires NDAs (Laura, can you confirm checklist?).

2) Escrow cadence & retention: Medisprint wants quarterly snapshots retained for 12 months. Proposed compromise: Redwood will produce quarterly signed snapshots and retain them for 12 months from snapshot date; for initial pilot we accept that. If Medisprint requires longer retention later we will revisit during renewal.

3) SCCs "on-site audit" language: Laura — can you call out any absolute blockers on the paragraph they inserted? If it's a notice-and-cooperate audit right (with reasonable scope and notice), we usually accept with an ops-aligned process. If they insist on unlimited on-site access, that's a no-go.

4) Order form & DocuSign path: attaching a draft Order Form link (DocuSign link in related_links). We will request Medisprint confirm exhibit names to match their DocuSign routing.

- Audit scope: Medisprint will accept a "notice + remote evidence review" for year-one; we will remove the blanket on-site audit ask in our next redline. If Redwood's ops team can provide documented remote evidence delivery, we will proceed.
- Retention: confirmed — quarterly snapshots retained for 12 months is acceptable for now; we'll include language that allows for business-review-triggered extension by mutual agreement.
- Order form exhibit names: Medisprint requires the DPA be Exhibit B and an "Export & Hosting" exhibit to be called Exhibit C. Please update the Order Form before DocuSign routing.

If you send an updated DPA (tracked) and an updated Order Form with exhibit mapping today, we can circulate internally and aim to route via DocuSign Friday.
